text:
keisha: Dropping a quick sketch + questions about the SLO alert preview density toggle. Mock: https://img.redwood.test/ui/density-toggle.png. Main tradeoffs: (A) show full suppression reason + end time inline (verboser) vs (B) condensed pill with countdown when close to expiry. Also: channel order visibility (numbers vs visible stack) and whether the preview should show immediate live diff when I tweak the threshold slider. Thoughts? :eyes: omar: I like a condensed default with an optional 'expanded' mode. Countdown is cool for short mutes (<1h) but confusing long-term. For order: show small priority numbers next to chips in compact mode, full stacked list when expanded. li: Accessibility: countdown must be exposed in screen reader text (e.g., "muted, ends in 9 minutes"). If we animate the countdown visually, update an offscreen `aria-live` region only once per minute to avoid noise. Also ensure the density toggle is keyboard operable and announced properly. sam: Copy angle: tone taxonomy suggestion: Friendly (Muted until 3:15 PM), Neutral (Suppressed · schedule), Technical (Suppressed until 2026-08-01T15:15Z by schedule). Default to Neutral visually, Friendly in onboarding/help. For live diff on threshold change: show a small inline preview row "If threshold -> 95% then expected notify: 3 channels" before commit. Helps avoid surprises. omar: UX nit: the condensed pill should include a chevron to expand reasons. When multiple suppressions exist show merged label "Muted · 2 reasons" and expanded list with precedence. Make sure actor (who muted) shows in expanded view. keisha: Good. Action items: @li to add aria snippet (example offscreen text + live region cadence), @sam to write 3 microcopy variants and add in doc, @omar to prototype density toggle + priority numbers. design-bot: Figma frame updated https://www.figma.com/file/density/toggle-v1 li: Quick aria example I'll add to the doc: offscreen `
PagerDuty muted, ends in 9 minutes
`; + guidance on one-update-per-minute. sam: I'll put the copy options in the doc and include examples for overlapping suppressions and countdowns. design-bot: Comment thread + prototype uploaded: https://www.figma.com/comments/567 keisha: Sync set for Tue 2pm to lock microcopy and a11y. Thanks! :handshake:
